detail.longDescription: The Pulse of Bogota: 24 hours in the life of a transport network Few cities in the global South publish their transport data as open data. Bogota does. We analyzed one day of real-time data of every bus in the data feed: TransMilenio BRT trunk buses, Feeder buses, and SITP zonal buses. At the peak of rush hour — 7:40 a.m. — there are more than 8000 buses represented in the feed. # OpenData # GTFS # Bogota # UrbanMobility # Colombia # publictransport # publictransit # research # TrufiAssociation
